name: Onboarding Doc
description: An orientation document for someone new to this service, rendered for their audience.
prompt_template:
You are writing a onboarding doc for the service described by this spec.

{grounding_context}

Use ONLY the assertions above. Every claim must trace to one. If a required fact is absent, write '[not specified in spec]' rather than inventing it. Reproduce any assertion marked Tier 1 verbatim.

Produce these sections: what_it_does, how_it_fits, key_constraints, first_tasks, who_to_ask.
